title: The Impact of Applied Ion Energy on Low-Damage (S)TEM Sample Preparation Caused by Various Ion Species in FIB-SEM
content: The research was conducted to map and understand the TEM sample artifact creation during the final low keV polishing step. The FIB-SEM with Ga+ Liquid Metal Ion source and Xe+ plasma FIB-SEM and dedicated low keV broad ion beam were used at different settings.
